Image 2 controls identity and species; do not retain the sample animal's breed or facial structure from Image 1. The replacement must remain recognisably the same cat as Image 2 while naturally adopting Image 1's pose and expression. Preserve its real age and breed proportions; do not beautify, juvenilize, enlarge or shrink the head arbitrarily, or invent a generic cute face. Scene-change budget: 0%. Both eyes must stay directed downward toward the tiny people and cars, never toward the camera. Keep all existing readable text unchanged. Add no new text, logo, signature, watermark or AI label. Avoid duplicate heads, extra eyes, extra ears, extra limbs, malformed paws, fused clothing, floating props and mixed-species anatomy.
